strategy: one approved multi-angle master reference pack per base design; every colour remains a separate purchasable SKU
catalogueOrder: Traverse ALL_COLLECTIONS in exact seed order, then traverse each collection's base designs in declaration order. Deduplicate colour variants by the item name before the em dash.

requiredConsistency: neutral master colour that does not override the purchased colour SKU
referencePolicy.subject: one complete garment only; no person, mannequin, hanger, rack, logo, text or unrelated prop

notes: The earlier per-colour image manifests remain preserved as legacy production evidence.
A master reference pack is not marked complete unless real Adobe asset IDs exist and every angle has been visually inspected.
When a pack is approved, apply it to every colour SKU using applyLamaloMasterReferencePack in server/_core/lamaloMasterReferences.ts.
Colour variants are never merged into one product row. Only their geometry reference pack is shared.
